title: Fractera Chain: coins for successful deals
description: The AGI network's own blockchain: coins for confirmed deals, a consensus network kept by developers.

blocks.text: Fractera Chain is the AGI network's own blockchain. Every successfully closed deal brings its participants Fractera coins, and developers keep the network running on their own computers.

When the validators' consensus confirms that a contract is fulfilled, coins go to the buyer, the contractor and the validators who checked the work. Coins reward results, not attempts: a rejected deal brings no coins.
Consensus nodes are run by developers on their own computers. A node checks the AGI network's transactions together with other nodes and earns coins for honest checking.
New coins are created only when the network confirms a deal. The number of coins grows with the number of useful deals, not by itself.
Coins bind all participants together: those who buy, build and check get a share in the network they make stronger.
